# Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor – Fleet Connectivity

**Company:** Corvale Mobility (fictional name; intercity rail and coach operator)
**Location:** Kraków, Poland (contract, remote-friendly; occasional office days)
**Engagement:** Service agreement (B2B / freelance), not an employment contract
**Rate:** 95 – 125 PLN per hour

## The engagement

Corvale is preparing a new generation of trains and needs a cloud infrastructure engineer for the team that links the vehicles to the company's cloud platform. You will help shape the architecture from the start and take it to production.

## Scope

- Design, build and operate the cloud infrastructure that links on-board train systems with backend services: telemetry ingestion, alerting, video streaming and remote content updates
- Maintain the infrastructure-as-code repository (Terraform with Terragrunt), keeping it tidy and approachable
- Lead technical proposals across backend and infrastructure from idea to production
- Contribute to system design and challenge decisions with arguments
- Set up secure train-to-cloud communication (mutual TLS, certificate management, network design)
- Agree interfaces and responsibilities with train manufacturers' engineers
- Support backend developers in deploying services that are easy to monitor and run
- Keep the platform observable, reliable and secure

## Requirements

- Hands-on infrastructure engineering and cloud environment design and operation
- AWS preferred; other major clouds acceptable
- Strong Terraform and Terragrunt
- Good understanding of systems architecture and system design
- Networking knowledge, including mTLS and SSL/TLS
- Practical security awareness
- Experience leading technical topics and bringing stakeholders along
- Strong analytical thinking and clear communication

**Nice to have:** IoT or automotive/remote-device integration, backend or full-stack background (JVM preferred), Linux and virtual machines.

## Working model

Independent contractor, invoicing monthly for agreed services.

Senior Platform Engineer | Site Reliability Engineer
nadia.brennanaziz@example.com | +44 7700 900909 | github.com/nba-sre-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Senior platform and site reliability engineer with 10 years of infrastructure experience, including production Kubernetes on AWS. Tech lead experienced in cloud infrastructure design and operation, system design, Terraform, developer platforms, observability, incident management and stakeholder engagement with product teams and leadership. Delivered self-service infrastructure, improved service reliability and reduced cloud costs while working with product teams and leadership.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Cloud infrastructure: AWS (EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS, S3, SQS, Route 53, CloudFront), Kubernetes, Linux, Terraform, Atlantis, Puppet
Platform engineering: Argo CD, Crossplane, Karpenter, Helm, Kustomize, GitHub Actions, Backstage catalog
Observability and reliability: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager, OpenTelemetry, Sloth, PagerDuty, SLOs and error budgets, incident management
Programming and testing: Go, Python, Bash, k6

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Platform Engineer | Tallybrook Ltd | Apr 2022–Present
B2B accounting SaaS
- Tech lead for a five-person platform team operating eight EKS clusters across three regions and approximately 350 services.
- Designed and built an internal developer platform with golden-path Go and Python service templates, Argo CD GitOps and Crossplane self-service for RDS, SQS and S3. Reduced time from new service to production from around two weeks to under one day; adopted by all 14 product teams.

- Served in the incident commander rotation and wrote the incident and post-mortem process.

Site Reliability Engineer | Brightwater Games | Jan 2019–Mar 2022
- Operated AWS infrastructure using EC2, ECS and EKS for game backends serving up to 1.2 million daily active players.
- Managed AWS infrastructure with Terraform, building approximately 40 modules and using Atlantis for pull-request plan and apply workflows.
- Replaced Nagios monitoring with Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager and Loki.
- Led capacity planning for two major launches. Used k6 to simulate 300,000 concurrent players and identified and fixed a connection-pool limit before launch.

Linux Systems Engineer | Pennine Hosting | Jul 2016–Dec 2018
- Managed approximately 600 Linux servers for hosting customers using Puppet configuration management.
- Automated operations in Bash and Python and participated in on-call support for customer incidents.

ADDITIONAL EXPERIENCE
- Mentored three backend engineers transitioning into SRE.
- Built an open-source Kubernetes controller in Go to delete expired preview namespaces; approximately 120 GitHub stars.
- Presented “SLOs that product managers care about” at a UK DevOps meetup in 2024.

EDUCATION
BSc Computer Science | University of the North Moors | 2016

CERTIFICATIONS
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) | 2021; renewed 2024
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional | 2023

LANGUAGES
English (native); Urdu (conversational)
